Body.Content:
Join us as we explore Azure Cosmos DB in our seven-part training series with interactive question and answer opportunities throughout. In addition to a technical deep dive on Azure Cosmos DB, this series covers a wide variety of topics, such as Graph API, Table API, and migrating Mongo DB applications to Azure Cosmos DB. You’ll learn about building serverless applications and conduct real-time analytics using Azure Cosmos DB, Azure Functions, and Spark connector.

Learn more and register for the training webinars.
